about: GymHound Motion Lab rig v2 (2026-10-17). 2D side view, faces +x. Hip-rooted skeleton; a root translation keeps the anchor (ankle or hand) fixed. Angles are ABSOLUTE segment angles in degrees, clockwise on screen, 0 = standing with arms hanging. Child rotation = child absolute - parent absolute. sampledFrames are ground truth for tests: a port must reproduce joints within 0.5 units.
viewBoxNote: Each exercise frames itself (see mockups); figure units are the same everywhere.
hierarchy: root(translate) > [hipCap, thigh(rot @hip) > [kneeCap, thigh art, shin(rot @knee) > [shin art, foot(rot @ankle) > foot art]], torso(rot @hip) > [glute (pelvis-attached) + torso art, head, upperArm(rot @shoulder) > [elbowCap, forearm(rot @elbow) > [forearm art, hand, prop], upper-arm art incl. deltoids]]]

hip.fill: hamstrings tier colour (so glute flows into hamstring)

jointCaps.note: Rounded deep-tissue caps drawn UNDER both segments so bending never opens a gap.

torso.note: The glute is attached to the pelvis (torso group), not the thigh, so it stays behind the hip in a hinge.

hand.note: Authored with grip centre at (150,226); translate by (0,-8.16) so it sits on HAND. Overhand grip = mirror about x=150 (matrix(-1 0 0 1 300 0)).

head.hairStrands: procedural: short strokes inside HAIR, pointing away from the crown (152.5,48.5), shorter toward the nape; see reference-generator/head.py crew_cut()

layering: per segment: silhouette > glow aura (blurred copy of worked groups) > base tissue + its volume pass > each worked muscle in a FLEX wrapper [muscle, its volume pass, sheen] > fibers > tendons

flex.curve: c = max(0, (effort - 0.35) / 0.65); scale(1 + grow*c, 1 - shorten*c) about the muscle group's own bounding-box centre

squat.title: Back Squat
squat.subtitle: Barbell · Legs

muscles.label: Quads
muscles.about: Quadriceps · primary. Straighten the knee and peak driving out of the bottom.

muscles.label: Glutes
muscles.about: Glutes · primary. Extend the hip, working hardest below parallel.

muscles.label: Adductors
muscles.about: Adductors · secondary. The big inner-thigh muscle helps the glutes drive the hip up out of the hole.

muscles.label: Hamstrings
muscles.about: Hamstrings · secondary. Steady the knee and help the hip extend.

muscles.label: Low back
muscles.about: Spinal erectors · stabilizer. Hold your torso angle under the bar.

muscles.label: Core
muscles.about: Core · stabilizer. Keeps pressure so the spine stays stacked.

muscles.label: Upper back
muscles.about: Upper back · stabilizer. Traps make a shelf so the bar sits still.

muscles.label: Lats
muscles.about: Lats · stabilizer. Pin the bar tight so it does not drift forward.

muscles.label: Calves
muscles.about: Calves · stabilizer. Keep the whole foot planted.

squat.solver: torso solved each frame so the bar (hand) stays at x=152; arms fixed to torso: uarm=torso+41.0, farm=torso-147.8

deadlift.title: Deadlift
deadlift.subtitle: Barbell · Posterior chain

muscles.label: Glutes
muscles.about: Glutes · primary. Drive the hips through to lockout.

muscles.label: Hamstrings
muscles.about: Hamstrings · primary. Pull the hips forward out of the hinge.

muscles.label: Low back
muscles.about: Spinal erectors · primary. Hold a flat back as the bar leaves the floor.

muscles.label: Quads
muscles.about: Quads · secondary. Push the floor away for the first few inches.

muscles.label: Adductors
muscles.about: Adductors · secondary. Help extend the hip from the start position.

muscles.label: Traps
muscles.about: Traps and upper back · secondary. Keep the shoulders packed under load.

muscles.label: Grip
muscles.about: Forearms · secondary. Your grip holds the whole lift.

muscles.label: Lats
muscles.about: Lats · stabilizer. Keep the bar tight against your legs.

muscles.label: Core
muscles.about: Core · stabilizer. Brace hard so the spine stays neutral.

deadlift.solver: torso solved each frame so the bar stays at x=160 (vertical bar path over midfoot); plate radius 40 so it sits on the floor at the start

pullup.title: Pull-up
pullup.subtitle: Bodyweight · Back

muscles.label: Lats
muscles.about: Lats · primary. Drive the elbows down to pull the body up.

muscles.label: Biceps
muscles.about: Biceps · secondary. Bend the elbow through the top half.

muscles.label: Mid back
muscles.about: Rhomboids and traps · secondary. Pull the shoulder blades down and together.

muscles.label: Rear delts
muscles.about: Rear delts · secondary. Help sweep the arm down.

muscles.label: Grip
muscles.about: Forearms · secondary. Hold the bar for the whole set.

muscles.label: Core
muscles.about: Core · stabilizer. Keeps the body from swinging.

pullup.solver: shoulder follows PULLUP_PATH (depth under bar, distance behind bar); arm solved by 2-link IK with the elbow on the low side

dips.title: Dips
dips.subtitle: Bodyweight · Chest & triceps

muscles.label: Triceps
muscles.about: Triceps · primary. Straighten the elbows to press back to lockout.

muscles.label: Chest
muscles.about: Chest · primary. Works harder the more you lean forward.

muscles.label: Front delts
muscles.about: Front delts · secondary. Help drive you up from the bottom.

muscles.label: Lower traps
muscles.about: Lower traps · stabilizer. Keep the shoulders down, away from the ears.

muscles.label: Core
muscles.about: Core · stabilizer. Stops the legs from swinging.

dips.solver: keyframes only; hands anchored on the bar

muscles.label: Biceps
muscles.about: Biceps and brachialis · primary. Bend the elbow against the weight.

muscles.label: Forearms
muscles.about: Brachioradialis · secondary. The forearm muscle that helps bend the elbow.

muscles.label: Front delts
muscles.about: Front delts · stabilizer. Hold the upper arm still at your side.

muscles.label: Core
muscles.about: Core · stabilizer. Stops you swinging the weight up.
